chunks: A recompense from your Lord, a sufficient gift,
ai.seo_question: What is the nature of the reward from God as described in Surah Al-Mursalat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Mursalat highlights the dual nature of divine recompense as both a precise settlement of deeds and an overflowing grace (Ata') from the Lord. It underscores that the believer's entry into Paradise is not merely a transactional payment but a generous bestowal that fully satisfies the spiritual account, reflecting God's mercy alongside His justice.
